name: H2 - Cover Effectiveness: Defenders with Cover vs Attackers in Open
hypothesis: H2: Units positioned behind/within obstacles receive a measurable survival advantage through the cover mechanic, reducing received damage and winning a disproportionate share of engagements.
description: One InfantrySquad behind scattered cover vs one InfantrySquad advancing across open ground. The defending unit starts in a cell surrounded by obstacles on 2-3 sides, maximizing cover_ratio. Both teams are symmetric in stats — only positioning differs.
expected_observations: The unit closer to cover or that reaches cover first should survive longer and win more engagements, demonstrating cover_ratio impact on hit_probability and calculate_damage.
